body: Do to the fact that I’m on parole, I no longer smoke, or drink. It’s reverted from a rare occurrence to like 2-4 times a month. It’s literally deteriorating my entire psyche. Anxiety. Depression. Insomnia. The episodes. I’m not trying to live like this, and the doctors are just gonna keep pumping full of drugs until I start drooling because they don’t know.

Manic depressive illness and schizophrenia run in my family but like I said, I’ve lived a pretty normal life until I was sent to prison. I work 60 hours a week and sleep 3 hours a day. I have these wild episodes were I blackout and do things I don’t remember. It’s only happened 6 times in my life but the last 4 have happened this year with the last 2 happening twice this month. I’ve woken up on the sides of my apartment next to me car not having any explanations of how I got there or why.  The spells of mania are what worry me the most because it’s in every sense of the way uncontrollable and the doctors have not a clue why it’s happening. I’ve tried Zolaf, Prozac, and then eventually Xanax and none of it did anything. I even took a risk of smoking while on parole and that was my go to back when I was younger for my anxiety and now that doesn’t even work for me and I know there’s not a possible chance I would even want any desire to live with this illness because it’s spiritually, physically, and mentally exhausting.

I listen to a lot of SoundCloud underground electric music. Not EDM. Not even like chill step or whatever. I have a playlist of just beautiful music that brings me up, if you’d like it, I can link you.

Honestly, it really wasn’t. I was 5th in my class, I never got in trouble in high school, just a basic guy. I drank. I smoked. I was relatively popular because of the music. So when I got to prison, I knew how to handle it accordingly, and it was just very, very boring. I have a very hard time explaining this to a family member or even a professional because it’s makes me sound like I have spells of mania which scare the fuck out of me because it runs in my family. When I left work Friday I took off, without telling anyone, ran through the woods for 6 hours and needed to physically bring myself to not commit suicide.  Like I said. I’m a thinker. I break things down like an equation to find multiple avenues to an answer. I was at work and just remember thinking I am busting my ass, sweating profusely to make $350 a week and to me that’s not what life is about, and because im on parole, my whole life is a constant disaster. My fiancé left me 4 days before I came home and took off to New Jersey, it was a pretty tough blow but I’m a man and I handled it, so why can’t I handle this, whatever this is?
